name: Cyprianus Nugroho Sulistyo Priyono
description: Documented New Zealand GIS and spatial-information contribution, 1993.
story: In 1993, Priyono submitted a Massey University thesis on using geographic information systems for farm soil conservation planning. The study examined how GIS could support land-resource and conservation decisions for a steep hill-country farm in the Āpiti district.

A 1993 New Zealand Soil News conference abstract lists C. S. N. Priyono, M. P. Tuohy and A. S. Palmer as co-authors of related work. The published abstract describes GIS as a planning tool. It documents the study and the authorship but does not establish an independent employment or software-development history.
